notes.title: Update 1.1 Autosave
notes.notes: Hi everyone! I'm excited to present the first major update for the game. The main addition: autosave when exiting the game and after each completed arcade. Previously, in the spirit of the roguelike genre, saving only occurred after completing a mission. However, the game is already challenging enough, and the autosave feature adds convenience. Thank you for your feedback!
